mapper.insert: INSERT INTO squad_workflow_snapshot (workspace_id, squad_id, input_hash, analysis_version, status, attempt_id, conversation_id, turn_id, requested_by, chief_version_id, input_json, graph_json, submission_receipts_json, submission_count, repair_count, deadline_at, error_code, error_detail, completed_at, row_version, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{squadId}, #{inputHash}, #{analysisVersion}, #{status}, #{attemptId}, #{conversationId}, #{turnId}, #{requestedBy}, #{chiefVersionId}, #{inputJson}, #{graphJson}, #{submissionReceiptsJson}, #{submissionCount}, #{repairCount}, #{deadlineAt}, #{errorCode}, #{errorDetail}, #{completedAt}, #{rowVersion}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM squad_workflow_snapshot WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND squad_id = #{squadId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM squad_workflow_snapshot WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE squad_workflow_snapshot SET status = #{status}, attempt_id = #{attemptId}, conversation_id = #{conversationId}, turn_id = #{turnId}, chief_version_id = #{chiefVersionId}, graph_json = #{graphJson}, submission_receipts_json = #{submissionReceiptsJson}, submission_count = #{submissionCount}, repair_count = #{repairCount}, deadline_at = #{deadlineAt}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_detail = #{errorDetail}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}

UPDATE squad_workflow_snapshot SET conversation_id = 0, row_version = row_version + 1, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND status IN ('GENERATING', 'REPAIRING') AND conversation_id IS NULL
